premises.text: Cameras are prevalent and can be programmed for new software development
premises.evidence_span: We live in a world surrounded by cameras.

premises.text: Monitoring systems for vulnerable individuals can be improved with camera access
premises.evidence_span: They could provide a much better service if they could access the cameras that are often in that location.

premises.text: Camera-related projects often face complexity and high costs
premises.evidence_span: This is very, very typical of many camera-related projects.

premises.text: Evercam simplifies camera integration for developers through a hosted API
premises.evidence_span: We try and reduce all of that complexity and expose to the software developer a beautiful, modern, hosted web API.

premises.text: Evercam guarantees compatibility with any internet-connected camera
premises.evidence_span: We guarantee, when software is written for our API, that it will work with any camera that can be connected to the internet.

premises.text: The Evercam platform enables visual verification for supply chain transactions
premises.evidence_span: Evercam enables, and it enables it at scale for these software developers to not have to worry about the hardware.

premises.text: Evercam provides a better service to developers compared to existing security products
premises.evidence_span: The difference is, with our company, our product is an API. It's entirely developer-focused.
